chunks: If only you could see when the sinners will stand before their Lord, heads hung low, (and say:) 'O Lord, we have seen and heard. So send us back. We shall do the right, for we have come to believe with certainty.'
ai.seo_question: What do the sinners say to God on the Day of Judgment in Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the regret of the disbelievers who, upon witnessing divine majesty, acknowledge the truth too late for their repentance to be accepted. The phrase 'inna muqinun' (we are certain) is interpreted as a sudden, undeniable realization of God's power rather than the firm faith required for salvation, marking the end of their opportunity for righteous action.
